hints.title: Locate Target Character
hints.text: Find the first occurrence index of character ch in the word.

hints.title: Prefix Slicing
hints.text: If ch is found at index idx, reverse the segment word[0..idx] and keep the remainder unchanged.

hints.title: Dual Boundary Scanning
hints.text: Reverse the slice word[:idx + 1] and concatenate word[idx + 1:].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass search and string slicing.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string concatenation without slicing can cause quadratic overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean handling of target presence and one-line slicing.
